api: Survicate Data Export API v2 (https://data-api.survicate.com/v2); provider artifact version: Data Export API v2
scope: Exact existing-surface evidence fallback: the preserved source inventory contains 9 official-survey operation entries, exactly matching the immutable count. Shared executable bindings for the same provider method/path are merged into one normalized endpoint. The cited official html_reference artifact is retained as the v2 provenance root; no operation was inferred from a documentation crawl. Prior source-surface scope: Pass B full-surface expansion: the Data Export API is a fixed, small, read-oriented surface (surveys, survey questions, responses, respondent attributes, GDPR personal-data) documented in full at developers.survicate.com/data-export/{survey,response,respondent,personal-data}. 3 read streams cover every list-shaped endpoint that has its own discovery path (surveys; survey_questions and responses fan out over every survey id). Respondent-scoped endpoints and the personal-data endpoints require a respondent_uuid/email obtained from an external source (there is no 'list all respondents' or 'list all emails' endpoint to fan out over), so they are excluded as requires_elevated_scope rather than modeled as streams. No write endpoints exist beyond the GDPR personal-data DELETE, which is excluded as destructive_admin.

operation.reason: GDPR personal-data counters lookup keyed by a single email address supplied by the caller; not a list-shaped/discoverable resource and has no natural incremental or full-refresh catalog semantics
operation.notes: named_dependency=engine.direct_read_executor: the direct-read executor has no non-redacting output policy for this provider operation

operation.reason: irreversibly deletes all survey responses, respondent records, and connected-service (Insights Hub) data for the given email address; a GDPR-erasure action, never a reverse-ETL-safe mutation
operation.notes: named_dependency=engine.rest_write_operation_contract: the REST write executor lacks a reviewed operation-specific body, risk, approval, and execution contract

operation.reason: no endpoint exists to enumerate respondent_uuid values across a workspace; a lone attributes-by-id GET with no discovery path is not a syncable stream without a respondent_uuid already in hand from an external source (e.g. one embedded in a responses-stream record)
